sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 87.88 x 162 x 48.26 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Galaxy Audio CPTS page (read by a research pass 2026-11-12): the sender has a 1/4 in speaker output (2 ohm or more), a 1/4 in balanced line output and an XLR line output (Hi, Low or Speaker selectable); the receiver has a 1/4 in balanced input and an XLR balanced input, one 9 V battery in each unit. The product is a two-unit set; one 87.88 x 162 x 48.26 mm box carries the ports of both (the proposal ports), so the set is modelled as one device, beta-modelled. XLR genders are not stated. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
